mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_POST ( member_idx, category_idx, range_idx, title, content, password, view_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberIdx}, #{categoryIdx}, #{rangeIdx}, #{title}, #{content}, #{password}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

SELECT p.idx, p.member_idx as memberIdx, p.category_idx as categoryIdx, p.range_idx as rangeIdx, p.title, p.content, p.view_count as viewCount, p.created_at as createdAt, p.updated_at as updatedAt, CASE WHEN p.range_idx = 16 THEN '익명' ELSE m.nick_name END as nickName, m.profile_image_url as profileImageUrl, c.code_name as categoryName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND comment_idx IS NULL) as likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_UNLIKE WHERE post_idx = p.idx AND comment_idx IS NULL) as unlikeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE post_idx = p.idx) as commentCount FROM TB_POST p LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON p.member_idx = m.idx LEFT JOIN TB_CODE c ON p.category_idx = c.idx WHERE p.range_idx != 15
AND p.category_idx = #{categoryIdx}
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND m.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at ASC
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC
ORDER BY likeCount DESC
ORDER BY unlikeCount DESC
ORDER BY commentCount DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
